meta.styleFamily: Glassmorphism, futuristic-white register (material-derived: cool glass + one warm metal)
meta.designPrinciple: Cool as brushed glass, warm exactly once -- the rose-gold never spreads past the one moment it's meant to mark.
meta.removedElement: First draft used the rose-gold accent on the primary CTA, the tab-bar active state, and link text -- three places for one 'warm metal' idea to show up read as an accent color, not a material contrast. Cut it down to exactly two surfaces that earn the metaphor: the orb's core glow and the single primary CTA. Everything else stays cool chrome and glass.

reducedMotion.strategy: the orb's drag-rotate and spring-back both collapse to an instant snap to the requested state; the blur-intensity transition on panel entry is disabled

signatureInteraction.library: Hand-rolled RAF integrator (numerically solves the damped mass-spring-damper equation F = -k*x - c*v frame by frame) -- not a third-party library, but a genuine simulation rather than an eased CSS transition, which is the actual distinction motion-icon-tiers.md's rule cares about. Switched from an initial CDN-loaded Motion (motion.dev) implementation after live testing surfaced integration issues with that library's handling of a directly-manipulated rotateY value; the self-contained version removes both the bug and the external network dependency for a file meant to work by opening it directly.
signatureInteraction.behavior: drag the glass orb horizontally -- it rotates in real 3D to show a different depth layer, release and it springs back to center with real momentum and one overshoot bounce.

dimensionality.behavior: the avatar is a real 3D object built from layered rotateY faces inside a perspective container, not a flat icon with a fake drop shadow -- dragging reveals genuinely different depth, not just a repositioned sprite.

iconography.styleDescriptor: 1.5px stroke, no fill, precise geometric proportions -- nothing hand-drawn, everything reads machined/manufactured

idle.description: Glass orb, slow ambient drift rotation, core holds a faint neutral glow.

listening.description: Core glow brightens one step, rotation pauses.

thinking.description: Core glow pulses steadily while the orb holds still.

needsApproval.description: Core glow snaps to approval violet, orb stills.

error.description: Core glow dims to a red tint.

success.description: Core glow flashes warm rose-gold once -- the second of exactly two places that color appears, see meta.removedElement.

elevationScale.note: The one 3D/signature-interaction surface in this system.

approvalBanner.entryMotion: single 200ms rise on cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), no loop

animationLibrary.name: n/a -- hand-rolled RAF spring integrator
animationLibrary.note: See motion.signatureInteraction for why this is self-contained rather than library-driven for this particular example.

react.name: Radix UI
react.note: Unstyled -- easier to layer blur/translucency without fighting a pre-styled component's own background, same reasoning as the existing glassmorphism example.
